description: Attach a verified workspace sender or update its project settings. Requires target project edit and explicit sender use permission. The verified application and sender must share the registrable main domain. Set exact From addresses; no per-prefix DNS is needed. Reply-To may name an external existing mailbox and a per-message value overrides the default. Attaching changes no sender DNS and grants no receiving access.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: mail_binding_set
